name: Wave Rider
summary: Throughout the Inner Sea region, wave riders patrol harbors, keeping them safe from dangerous sea creatures and watching for smugglers. The most famous of these is the hippocampus-riding Sea Cavalry of Absalom.
mechanicalNotes: Replacement progression is automated. Bespoke effects without a shared builder subsystem remain descriptive.

features.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
features.summary: Wave riders are proficient with all simple and martial weapons and with light and medium armor, but not with shields. This replaces the cavalier’s weapon and armor proficiencies.

features.name: Seafaring Companion
features.summary: At 1st level, a wave rider gains Monstrous Mount as a bonus feat. The wave rider can use this feat only to select a hippocampus mount . Otherwise, this ability functions identically to and replaces the cavalier’s mount ability.
